title: GMS Week 43 - Freight Refuses to Stay Down
section_path: GMS Week 43 - Freight Refuses to Stay Down
section_path_text: GMS Week 43 - Freight Refuses to Stay Down
summary:
Main
Last week's dry freight retreat appeared to offer recycling buyers the opening they had been waiting for. It did not last.The Baltic Dry Index recovered from 2,545 on October 15 to 2,693 on Thursday, October 22, led by improving Capesize earnings. Although still below earlier October levels, the recovery has restored some confidence in continued trading.
